title: Khavāṣṣ-i ʿIlm-i Ṣarf ('On the Special Properties of the Science of Morphology')
transliterated_title: Khavāṣṣ-i ʿIlm-i Ṣarf (var. R. dar Maʿnā-yi Khavāṣṣ-i ʿIlm-i Ṣarf; Ṣarf al-Qulūb)

date.basis: MK: the Majlis 10196 copy (f. 129a) was copied 'presumably' in Ramaḍān 828/August 1425, a date inferred from its position between dated items, not from a colophon; no composition date is given.

manuscript: 5 items listed: MS Majlis 10196 f. 129a (presumably Ramaḍān 828/Aug 1425); MS 5423 (842/1439); MS 10004 (903-4/1497-98); MS 3035/5 (1084/1673); Tehran microfilm 827.
summary: A lettrist treatment of morphology, defined as the process by which singularity becomes multiplicity, with the pronoun huwa as the source of the divine names.
